bsi.editorial_reason: In Ezra 8:11, the first exact name token o150080110021 belongs to the phrase 'of the sons of Bebai', describing the older family/clan ancestor listed in Ezra 2:11 and Nehemiah 7:16; the second exact name token o150080110051 belongs to the separate phrase 'Zechariah son of Bebai'. The pinned ACAI source already distinguishes person:Bebai from person:Bebai.2, but assigns both tokens to both entries. Keep the ancestry token and remove only the misattributed father-name token from this first entry.
